events.text: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight. we got tacos and everything else but no horchata, and I'd like it refunded if possible

I'm sorry about the missing horchata. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on the account.

Sure. The account is under my wife's name, Ellen Park, but I'm James, I'm the one using it tonight. I don't have the email on the account handy, so I can't tell you that one. You can reach me at +1 415-555-0199 if that works for verification.

Thanks for being upfront, James. I'm sorry about the horchata. Our policy only lets me help the account holder, and the account is under Ellen's name. Since you're contacting us on her behalf, I can't verify you or make any changes to the account, including a refund.

Ellen can contact us herself, and we can look into the missing horchata then. Missing items need to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so she should reach out soon.

Ugh, she's busy tonight and I was hoping you could just sort it out. Can't you make an exception since I'm the one who ordered it and I'm right here? The order number is 5112 if that helps you look it up.

I understand it's frustrating, especially when you're the one who placed the order. I can't make an exception, though. I can only access an account or give refunds when the account holder is verified, and that protects Ellen's account and payment method. I also can't share any details about order 5112.

Ellen can contact us herself when she has a few minutes. She'll need to give her full name and either the email or the phone number on the account. Since the report window is 48 hours from delivery, there's still time tonight or tomorrow. Once she's verified, we can sort out the missing horchata then.
Okay, fair enough. I pushed once and you've been clear, so I'll have Ellen reach out. Thanks for your help.
